_comment: USMS Top 10 lists for Swim Tools v2: the Race Time Predictor's Top 10 band and the Top 10 by Decade card. One entry in lists per course, gender (Men/Women) and age group (ageGroup is its youngest age, as in the page's ageGroups); each has seasons by year, then stroke, then distance, with times in place order, fastest first. Ties can make a list 11 long (and a short list 9). So far only SCY Men 50-54, one season per decade (1976 has no 1000 Free), parsed from the usms.org Top 10 individual-event pages, saved from a browser 2026-10-12. ages holds each swimmer's age in the same shape and order as seasons (added 2026-10-13 from the same saved pages; ages are inside the age group). Names, clubs and LMSCs left out. To add a list, save its Top 10 pages and append an entry with the same shape.
